name: markovo
description: Convert PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and authorized public HTTPS pages (Google Docs, Notion, GitHub, Hacker News, YouTube) into clean, structured Markdown for agent context. Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint with OAuth 2.1, plus a local stdio server sandboxed to a dedicated root directory.

MARKOVO_API_KEY.description: API key created at https://markovo.net/app#developer (required for the local stdio server; the remote endpoint uses OAuth 2.1 instead)

MARKOVO_MCP_ROOT.description: Dedicated existing directory that bounds all local file reads and writes; file tools fail closed when it is missing

tools.name: markovo_convert
tools.description: Convert a supported file through the account-metered Markovo API.

tools.name: markovo_convert_url
tools.description: Convert one public HTTPS page after explicit consent to Markovo's isolated remote fetch.

tools.name: markovo_job_assets
tools.description: List manifest-verified image assets for a completed job.

tools.name: markovo_asset_url
tools.description: Create a revocable 60-600 second bearer URL for one Bundle image.

tools.name: markovo_asset_revoke
tools.description: Revoke a temporary asset URL before it expires.

tools.name: markovo_doctor
tools.description: Check client, service, and API-key readiness.

uvx.description: Local stdio server via PyPI; file tools sandboxed to MARKOVO_MCP_ROOT

remote.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint; MCP hosts discover OAuth 2.1 metadata automatically (scopes markovo:read / markovo:convert). Recommended.
